Taking the antiderivative and evaluating the difference at the bounds, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{\int }_{\pi /2}^{5\pi /6}{csc}^{2}⁡x\,\text{d}x & =-\operatorname{cot}⁡x{|}_{\pi /2}^{5\pi /6} \\  & =-\operatorname{cot}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{6})-(-\operatorname{cot}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2})) \\  & =-(-\sqrt{3})-0 \\  & =\sqrt{3}.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
